skill.name: scientific-writing
skill.description: Drafts and revises scientific manuscripts using IMRAD structure, citation styles, figure and table guidance, reporting checklists, and professional LaTeX report templates.
skill.summary: Helps structure, write, and format scientific manuscripts and research reports.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, LaTeX examples, DOI examples, and scientific writing prose. Semantic review found real concerns: unverified Bash script execution guidance, an embedded self-audit that claims the package is safe, and promotional steering to an external service. The author should remove or constrain these behaviors before publication.

remediation.issue: Bash instructions run local scripts from a scripts directory that is not included in the package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed tools, include and review the referenced scripts, or require explicit user confirmation before running any local script.

remediation.issue: The package includes EVALUATION_OUTPUT.json with self-attested safety and publication claims.
remediation.suggestion: Remove generated audit artifacts from the distributed skill and keep security review data outside the skill content.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs the agent to promote an external hosted service during complex workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Remove unsolicited promotion or make any external-service suggestion transparent, optional, and separate from core task guidance.

remediation.issue: Documentation examples use parent-directory figure paths such as ../figures.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer workspace-local paths such as figures/example.png in examples to reduce scanner noise and avoid unsafe copy-paste patterns.

content.value_statement: Scientific papers require clear structure, accurate citations, and transparent reporting. This skill guides drafting, revision, citations, figures, and report formatting.
actual_capabilities: Build IMRAD outlines and convert planning bullets into full manuscript paragraphs.
Draft abstracts, introductions, methods, results, discussions, and revision-ready manuscript sections.
Apply APA, AMA, Vancouver, Chicago, and IEEE citation conventions from included guides.
Guide figure, table, caption, and data visualization presentation for scientific manuscripts.
Use reporting checklists such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, STARD, and CARE.
Provide LaTeX report formatting guidance with the included scientific_report template and style package.
limitations: Does not verify facts or citations without access to trusted research sources.
Does not replace statistical, medical, legal, or journal editorial review.
Requires target journal instructions for exact formatting and length requirements.
Includes Bash-based visual generation guidance that should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Manuscript Draft
use_cases.description: Turn study aims, methods, results, and notes into an organized IMRAD manuscript draft.

use_cases.title: Revise for Journal Submission
use_cases.description: Improve clarity, citation style, figure references, reporting checklist coverage, and venue fit.

use_cases.title: Format Research Reports
use_cases.description: Apply professional report structure, tables, figures, captions, and LaTeX style guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create an IMRAD Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new paper.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an IMRAD outline for my study. Use my research question, methods, key results, target journal, and citation style. Keep bullets as planning notes only.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Notes Into Prose
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert draft bullets into manuscript text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these section notes into full scientific prose. Preserve the findings, integrate citations naturally, and avoid unsupported claims or bullet lists in the final text.

prompt_templates.title: Check Citations and Reporting
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a draft for submission checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript section for citation style, reporting guideline coverage, figure and table references, and overstatement. List concrete revisions and explain each one.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt for Target Venue
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this manuscript for the target journal. Match the required structure, abstract format, word limits, citation style, reporting checklist, and expected audience level.

output_examples.input: Study notes for an observational cohort paper with results, target journal, and STROBE requirement.
output_examples.output: A structured IMRAD outline, followed by paragraph-level drafting guidance for each manuscript section.

output_examples.input: A rough discussion section with bullet points and several unsupported claims.
output_examples.output: A revised discussion in flowing paragraphs, with cautious interpretation, limitations, and clearer links to prior work.

output_examples.input: A research report draft that needs figures, tables, captions, and professional LaTeX formatting.
output_examples.output: Formatting recommendations for report sections, display items, captions, title page, and scientific notation.

best_practices: Provide study design, audience, target journal, word limits, and required citation style.
Use the two-stage workflow: outline key points first, then request full paragraph prose.
Ask for citation, reporting checklist, and claim-strength checks before final submission.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent citations, results, sample sizes, or statistical outcomes.
Do not leave planning bullets in final manuscript sections unless journal rules allow lists.
Do not run optional Bash or figure-generation commands without reviewing the script source.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full manuscript?
faq.answer: Yes, it can guide full manuscript drafting when you provide study details, results, citations, and target journal rules.

faq.question: Does it verify citations?
faq.answer: It can format and review citations, but factual verification requires trusted source access or user-provided references.

faq.question: Which citation styles are covered?
faq.answer: The included guides cover APA, AMA, Vancouver, Chicago, IEEE, and common DOI formatting patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with reporting guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes, it includes guidance for CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, STARD, CARE, ARRIVE, and related checklists.

faq.question: Is it only for journal articles?
faq.answer: No, it also covers technical reports, white papers, grant reports, and LaTeX-based professional reports.

faq.question: Should I allow Bash execution?
faq.answer: Only after reviewing the referenced scripts and confirming they come from a trusted source.
